description: This Java class 'OrderChangeHelper' provides helper methods for managing non-read actions related to orders within the OFBiz framework. It supports order approval, rejection, completion, cancellation, and status updates, along with inventory reservation and payment authorization management.

classes.name: OrderChangeHelper
classes.description: A final utility class containing static helper methods for processing order status changes, inventory reservations, and payment handling.

methods.name: approveOrder
methods.description: Approves an order, updating its status and related items; can hold or approve immediately.

methods.name: rejectOrder
methods.description: Rejects an order, updating statuses and cancelling reservations and payments.

methods.name: completeOrder
methods.description: Marks an order as completed, creating invoices and received payments.

methods.name: cancelOrder
methods.description: Cancels an order, updating statuses, releasing reservations, and payment authorizations.

methods.name: orderStatusChanges
methods.description: Updates the order header, items, and digital items statuses via appropriate service calls.

methods.name: cancelInventoryReservations
methods.description: Cancels inventory reservations related to an order.

methods.name: releasePaymentAuthorizations
methods.description: Releases payment authorizations for the specified order.

methods.name: createReceivedPayments
methods.description: Creates payment records for received payments based on order payment preferences.

methods.name: createOrderInvoice
methods.description: Generates an invoice for the specified order.
